## ROLE SPECIFIC RULE 3. Security and Command must be competent, with positive impact.
All command and security players are held to higher expectations and stricter interpretations of the rules. This includes non-antagonists who are promoted to or gain the job position during the round in any way. They must attempt to have an overall positive impact on the round for other crew-aligned players.
While they are not expected to entirely obey space law, they should generally not cooperate with or allow known antagonists to have any major negative impact. Any form of corruption must be a response to circumstances and roleplayed, without intent of causing problems for other command or security members, or the station as a whole.
These are not roles meant for inexperienced players. They are not expected to know how to operate an entire department, but must display general competence in their departments and job duties. Department heads should not abuse their power or authority against other roles in their departments, or be a burden for the department as a whole as a result of their incompetent or unreasonable actions.
